notes: Partition verified: 36 source and 42 target ids each used once across 36 units.

s006 takes *this* under rule 41's determiner clause because no demonstrative morpheme is present to license it — the opposite of JER.1.10, where זֶה is written and the articles go unrepresented; both verses were read on their own morphology.
The three resultative lameds are unrepresented: *made thee a fortified city* spends no English word on the result relation, so rule 49's frame clause has nothing to place and rule 40 governs.
The three construct chains rendered attributively follow rule 28, and the closing *the people of the land* is rule 29's arthrous-rendering case with the article taking the *the* before its own word.
The later lameds at s023, s026, s029 and s033 are a different construction and each takes the written *against*.
